other_conditions: The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board (GBOCWWB).
The registration with the board must be for at least 2 years before applying.
The house is allotted jointly to a registered construction worker husband or wife, and either spouse must be a registered construction worker.
No land, property, or building should be in the name of the registered construction worker, the spouse, or any family member.
The benefit is given once per family.
The application must be made after one year of house allotment.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹1,60,000 is provided to eligible registered construction workers.
